end.summary:
• Practised everyday uses of non-metals, including graphite in pencils, chlorine in water, nitrogen in packets and fertilisers, and iodine in salt.
• Connected nitrogen in fertilisers with plant growth and protein formation; this still needs checking in a new situation.
• Practised naming non-metals and their states; easy questions were answered right, but a why or new-situation check is still needed.
• Chlorine’s role was corrected later: it kills germs in water, not mainly to change colour or add smell.
• Iodised salt’s purpose and some rocket-fuel and balloon uses remain to be checked next time.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how non-metals are used in daily life, including graphite in pencils, chlorine for killing germs in water, nitrogen in food packets and fertilisers, and sulphur in rubber. Pari gave several connections and corrected the chlorine mix-up later in the lesson; iodised salt was still mixed up with taste, and a few uses were not yet recalled. At home, ask them to sort examples into “use” and “state” and explain one reason for each.

Koi baat nahi. Sulphur powder hai, toh woh solid hai; doosre container mein chlorine gas hai. Ab isi se ek chhota step: room temperature par iodine crystals solid, liquid ya gas hain?
iodine crystals solid hoga na, kyunki crystals hain toh solid hi hota hai, jaise chini ke crystals – room temperature pe woh pighalta nahi, thos rehta hai

Haan, iodine crystals room temperature par solid hote hain; chini ke crystals se aapki tulna sahi hai. Non-metals sirf gases nahi hote: iodine aur sulphur solid hain, jabki chlorine gas hai. Ab pichhli baat se yaad karke bataiye, woh peela non-metal powder kaunsa hai jo rubber ko mazboot banane mein use hota hai?
arrey haan, woh peela powder sulphur hai na! rubber ko mazboot banata hai, jaise cycle ke tyre mein hota hai, aur dawaiyon mein bhi use karte hain

Haan, sulphur wahi peela solid non-metal hai jo tyre ke rubber ko mazboot banane mein kaam aata hai. Ab hawa ki baat: agar uske 100 barabar hisse hon, toh lagbhag kitne oxygen aur kitne nitrogen honge?
